title: JVM internals for Kotlin and Android developers
intro: Trace a tiny bookmark program from compiled instructions to method frames, shared objects and reachability.
how: Start by tracing one tiny program. Use the browser workbench to predict what changes in a frame or on the heap. Then use a local JDK to compare the model with compiled instructions and run the shared-counter exercise.

modules.title: From source to a live object
modules.blurb: Follow the same counter through four experiments.
